selection_rule.primary: 160-frame passing windows sorted by sequence lexicographic, track_id numeric, clip_start numeric; take first
selection_rule.fallback: only if zero passing 160-frame windows, choose 120-frame passing windows in same order
selection_rule.inspection_queue: first passing 160-frame window per sequence, first 12 sequences; if none use 120-frame; representatives additionally retained

candidate.split_role: extra development only; not official validation or test

limits: Image-coordinate motion is not physical motion; camera motion and actual stop/restart remain unverified.
Annotated presence is not verified continuous visibility.
Prescreen labels are annotation candidates, not established events or model failures.
No model prediction, score, mask, or error is used to choose candidates.
Rectangular segmentation is not verified pixel segmentation.
Exact sequence exclusion does not establish different capture scene or camera trajectory.
